title: vicia abbreviata subsp. balansae
intro: Vicia abbreviata subsp. balansae, commonly known as the Balansa vetch or Balansa pea, is a plant species in the legume family Fabaceae. It is a medicinal plant used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Balansa vetch include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
